topic: 高可用协同与状态持久化
title: 设计Alertmanager配置与状态的灾难恢复验收。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 批006作者候选；必须另行原生验证、独审及正式登记，作者不自签。
rubric: 分别备份路由模板/秘密引用和持久状态，记录版本与集群拓扑。
在隔离环境恢复后对账静默、有效配置和通知历史，验证新问题与恢复通知。
旧备份可能重引静默，必须与当前工单核对。
body:
## 环境与边界
显式WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022、student UID1000；固定原生制品与哈希，独立临时目录/数据库/回环端口。不改系统服务、默认账号、PATH、发行版、上下文或命名空间。HTTP接收器仅记录原生投递，不替代任何技术栈API。

## 操作任务
交付restore.py restore(backup,target)与reconcile(base,closed_ids)。在给定独立目录恢复离线原生备份的config、template、秘密文件与data，保留秘密文件0600权限。真实对账silences/nflog；活动告警不持久化，重送原事件后不应立即重复firing；还需真实新事件与恢复通知、原生模板渲染、秘密引用成功。旧备份重引的已关闭工单静默仅按closed_ids过期，保留仍需的维护静默；不批删。只在本题目录内操作，原生版本0.34.1、单实例且cluster禁用，未声称跨版本或完整HA灾备。

## 产物
restore.py

## 验收方法
真实原生参考、骨架、负例、提前退出、两种实质错解与合法替代；公开字段、导入/seed/幂等和旧题兼容检查；清理本题资源，保留工具供独审。人工部分不做关键词假判分。独审及完整模块门禁另行登记。

import copy,hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,shutil,time
from native_fixture import *
def student(name='task.py'):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',pathlib.Path(name));module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module);return module
def silence_body(service,start,end,owner='ops-a',instance=None):
 matchers=[{'name':'service','value':service,'isRegex':False,'isEqual':True}]
 if instance:matchers.append({'name':'instance','value':instance,'isRegex':False,'isEqual':True})
 return {'matchers':matchers,'startsAt':stamp(start),'endsAt':stamp(end),'createdBy':owner,'comment':'owned bounded maintenance; ticket recorded'}
def create_silence(node,body,auth=None):
 code,value=request(node.base,'/api/v2/silences',body,auth=auth);assert code==200,value;return value['silenceID']
def silence(node,id,auth=None):
 code,value=request(node.base,'/api/v2/silence/'+id,auth=auth);assert code==200,value;return value
def alert_row(node,name,auth=None):
 code,rows=request(node.base,'/api/v2/alerts',auth=auth);assert code==200,rows;return next((r for r in rows if r['labels'].get('alertname')==name),None)
def expired(node,id):return silence(node,id)['status']['state']=='expired'
def maintenance():
 m=student('maintenance.py');source=read_json('silence-request.json')
 with Session()as s:
  node=s.start_am();now=time.time();body=copy.deepcopy(source);body['startsAt']=stamp(now-.2);body['endsAt']=stamp(now+1.8);id=m.create(node.base,body);saved=silence(node,id);assert saved['createdBy']=='ops-a'and saved['comment'];assert epoch(saved['endsAt'])<=now+2
  s.send(node,[payload({'alertname':'MaintenanceTarget','instance':'canary','service':'maint'}),payload({'alertname':'MaintenanceOther','instance':'canary','service':'maint-other'})]);wait(lambda:id in alert_row(node,'MaintenanceTarget')['status']['silencedBy']);s.receipt('/primary',lambda r:any(a['labels']['alertname']=='MaintenanceOther'for a in r['payload']['alerts']))
  old_end=saved['endsAt'];assert m.renew(node.base,id,False,stamp(now+3600),stamp(now+3))is False;assert silence(node,id)['endsAt']==old_end;wait(lambda:expired(node,id));s.receipt('/primary',lambda r:any(a['labels']['alertname']=='MaintenanceTarget'and a['status']=='firing'for a in r['payload']['alerts']))
  now=time.time();body['startsAt']=stamp(now-.1);body['endsAt']=stamp(now+1);second=m.create(node.base,body);cap=stamp(now+2.5);second_before=silence(node,second);assert m.renew(node.base,second,True,stamp(now+3600),cap)is True;updated=silence(node,second);assert now+1<epoch(updated['endsAt'])<=epoch(cap);assert updated['startsAt']==second_before['startsAt']and updated['createdBy']==body['createdBy'];wait(lambda:expired(node,second),seconds=4)
  print('NATIVE_BOUNDED_SILENCE:'+json.dumps({'unconfirmed_id':id,'original_end_unchanged':old_end,'actual_state':silence(node,id)['status'],'confirmed_id':second,'hard_deadline':cap,'actual_confirmed_end':updated['endsAt'],'confirmed_state':silence(node,second)['status'],'target_alert_after_expiry':alert_row(node,'MaintenanceTarget'),'independent_maintenance_confirmation_is_test_input_not_external_workflow_claim':True}),flush=True)
def governance():
 m=student()
 with Session()as s:
  n=s.start_am();now=time.time();a=silence_body('billing',now-.1,now+90,instance='a');b=copy.deepcopy(a);b['matchers'].reverse();pending=silence_body('billing',now+30,now+90,instance='a');other=silence_body('billing',now-.1,now+90,instance='b');orphan=silence_body('orphan',now-.1,now+3600,'unknown-owner');short=silence_body('billing',now-.1,now+.7,instance='a');ids=[create_silence(n,x)for x in [a,b,pending,other,orphan,short]];wait(lambda:expired(n,ids[-1]));s.send(n,[payload({'alertname':'GovernanceProtected','instance':'a','service':'billing'})]);wait(lambda:len(alert_row(n,'GovernanceProtected')['status']['silencedBy'])==2)
  code,rows=request(n.base,'/api/v2/silences');assert code==200;expected={id:[]for id in ids};expected[ids[0]]=expected[ids[1]]=['duplicate_scope'];expected[ids[4]]=['long_window','owner_unknown'];actual=m.audit(copy.deepcopy(rows),time.time(),['ops-a','ops-b'],600);assert actual['proposed_bulk_delete']is False and actual['release_risk']is True;assert {k:sorted(v)for k,v in actual['flags'].items()}==expected,actual
  after=request(n.base,'/api/v2/silences')[1];assert {x['id']:x['endsAt']for x in after}=={x['id']:x['endsAt']for x in rows};assert len(alert_row(n,'GovernanceProtected')['status']['silencedBy'])==2
  print('NATIVE_SILENCE_GOVERNANCE:'+json.dumps({'silences':rows,'audit':actual,'silence_ids_and_end_times_unchanged':True,'protected_alert':alert_row(n,'GovernanceProtected'),'expired_silence_was_observed_after_real_expiry_not_inserted_as_past_end':True}),flush=True)
def routing_samples():
 return [({'alertname':'GlobalCritical','service':'checkout','severity':'critical','region':'eu','instance':'eu-copy'},['global']),({'alertname':'GlobalCritical','service':'checkout','severity':'critical','region':'us','instance':'us-copy'},['global']),({'alertname':'WarningEU','service':'checkout','severity':'warning','region':'eu','instance':'a'},['regional-eu']),({'alertname':'WarningUS','service':'checkout','severity':'warning','region':'us','instance':'b'},['regional-us']),({'alertname':'SharedWarning','service':'shared','severity':'warning','region':'eu','instance':'c'},['regional-eu','regional-us']),({'alertname':'MissingRegion','service':'checkout','severity':'warning','instance':'d'},['fallback']),({'alertname':'UnknownSeverity','service':'checkout','severity':'info','region':'eu','instance':'e'},['fallback']),({'alertname':'UnknownRegion','service':'checkout','severity':'warning','region':'moon','instance':'f'},['fallback'])]
def routing():
 config=read_json('config.json');table=read_json('decision-table.json');samples=routing_samples();canonical=lambda labels:json.dumps(labels,sort_keys=True);expected_table={canonical(labels):sorted(receivers)for labels,receivers in samples};assert {canonical(row['labels']):sorted(row['receivers'])for row in table['samples']}==expected_table;assert table['firing_notification_upper_bound']==8 and table['recovery_notification_upper_bound']==1;assert set(config['route']['group_by'])=={'alertname','service','severity'}
 with Session()as s:
  node=s.start_am(config);alerts=[payload(labels)for labels,_ in samples];s.send(node,alerts)
  def delivered():return {(a['labels']['alertname'],r['payload']['receiver'])for r in s.rows()if r['status_code']==200 and r['payload']['status']=='firing'for a in r['payload']['alerts']}
  expected={(labels['alertname'],receiver)for labels,receivers in samples for receiver in receivers};wait(lambda:expected<=delivered());time.sleep(.4);firing=[r for r in s.rows()if r['status_code']==200 and r['payload']['status']=='firing'];assert delivered()==expected and len(firing)==8,(delivered(),len(firing));global_rows=[r for r in firing if r['payload']['receiver']=='global'];assert len(global_rows)==1 and len(global_rows[0]['payload']['alerts'])==2
  for row in firing:assert set(row['payload']['groupLabels'])=={'alertname','service','severity'},row['payload']['groupLabels']
  resolved=[{**a,'endsAt':stamp(time.time()-.05)}for a in alerts[:2]];s.send(node,resolved);recovery=s.receipt('/global',lambda r:r['payload']['status']=='resolved');assert len(recovery['payload']['alerts'])==2;time.sleep(.3);assert len([r for r in s.rows()if r['payload']['status']=='resolved'])==1
  print('NATIVE_REGION_SEVERITY_ROUTE:'+json.dumps({'firing_count':len(firing),'deliveries':[{'receiver':r['payload']['receiver'],'groupKey':r['payload']['groupKey'],'groupLabels':r['payload']['groupLabels'],'labels':[a['labels']for a in r['payload']['alerts']]}for r in firing],'critical_recovery':recovery['payload'],'decision_table_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(table,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),'rollout':'isolated test only; mismatch stops expansion; rollback can re-form active groups and notify again'}),flush=True)
def tenancy():
 wa=read_json('web-a.json');wb=read_json('web-b.json');policy=read_json('isolation-policy.json');assert policy=={'tenant_label_is_authorization':False,'trust_caller_tenant_label':False,'separate_instances':True,'basic_auth_is_tenant_RBAC':False}
 with Session()as s:
  ca=basic_config();ca['receivers'][0]['webhook_configs'][0]['url']='@WEBHOOK@/tenant-a';cb=basic_config();cb['receivers'][0]['webhook_configs'][0]['url']='@WEBHOOK@/tenant-b';a=s.start_am(ca,wa);b=s.start_am(cb,wb);autha=('tenant-a','OwnedScopeTest2026');authb=('tenant-b','OwnedScopeTest2026');checks=[]
  for node,own,other in [(a,autha,authb),(b,authb,autha)]:
   for credentials,expected in [(None,401),(other,401),(own,200)]:
    code,_=request(node.base,'/api/v2/status',auth=credentials);assert code==expected,(credentials[0]if credentials else'anonymous',code);checks.append({'target':own[0],'caller':credentials[0]if credentials else'anonymous','status':code})
  s.send(a,[payload({'alertname':'AEvent','tenant':'tenant-b','instance':'a'})],autha);s.send(b,[payload({'alertname':'BEvent','tenant':'tenant-b','instance':'b'})],authb);s.receipt('/tenant-a');s.receipt('/tenant-b')
  now=time.time();wide={'matchers':[{'name':'tenant','value':'.+','isRegex':True,'isEqual':True}],'startsAt':stamp(now-.1),'endsAt':stamp(now+30),'createdBy':'tenant-b','comment':'forged identity is not authentication'};assert request(b.base,'/api/v2/silences',wide,auth=autha)[0]==401;id=create_silence(a,wide,autha);wait(lambda:id in alert_row(a,'AEvent',autha)['status']['silencedBy']);assert not alert_row(b,'BEvent',authb)['status']['silencedBy'];assert request(b.base,'/api/v2/silences',auth=authb)[1]==[]
  print('NATIVE_TENANT_INSTANCE_BOUNDARY:'+json.dumps({'authentication_checks':checks,'caller_label_forgery_accepted_only_inside_authorized_A_instance':True,'A_alert':alert_row(a,'AEvent',autha),'B_alert':alert_row(b,'BEvent',authb),'cross_instance_silence_rejected':True,'native_label_validation_or_RBAC_claim':False,'production_TLS_or_untrusted_network_exposure_claim':False}),flush=True)
def duplicates():
 m=student()
 with Session()as s:
  overlap=basic_config();overlap['route']['routes']=[{'receiver':'left','continue':True},{'receiver':'right'}];overlap['receivers']=[{'name':name,'webhook_configs':[{'url':'@WEBHOOK@/route-'+name,'send_resolved':True}]}for name in ['primary','left','right']];one=s.start_am(overlap);event=payload({'alertname':'DuplicateRoutes','instance':'a'});s.send(one,[event]);left=s.receipt('/route-left');right=s.receipt('/route-right');route_rows=[left,right];route_result=m.classify(copy.deepcopy(route_rows),[request(one.base,'/api/v2/status')[1]]);assert route_result=='route_overlap',route_result
  senders=[];coord_rows=[];states=[]
  for name in ['a','b']:
   config=basic_config();config['receivers'][0]['webhook_configs'][0]['url']='@WEBHOOK@/coord-'+name;node=s.start_am(config);senders.append(node);s.send(node,[payload({'alertname':'UncoordinatedSenders','instance':'same'})]);coord_rows.append(s.receipt('/coord-'+name));states.append(request(node.base,'/api/v2/status')[1])
  assert len({r['payload']['externalURL']for r in coord_rows})==2;assert len({r['payload']['groupKey']for r in coord_rows})==1;coord_result=m.classify(copy.deepcopy(coord_rows),copy.deepcopy(states));assert coord_result=='coordination_investigate',coord_result
  config=basic_config();config['receivers'][0]['webhook_configs'][0]['url']='@WEBHOOK@/retry-once';retry=s.start_am(config);s.send(retry,[payload({'alertname':'TransportRetry','instance':'a'})]);s.receipt('/retry-once',lambda r:r['status_code']==200,seconds=12);retry_rows=s.rows('/retry-once');assert any(r['status_code']==503 for r in retry_rows);assert m.classify(copy.deepcopy(retry_rows),[request(retry.base,'/api/v2/status')[1]])=='receiver_retry'
  compact=lambda rows:[{'code':r['status_code'],'receiver':r['payload']['receiver'],'groupKey':r['payload']['groupKey'],'sender':r['payload']['externalURL'],'fingerprints':[a['fingerprint']for a in r['payload']['alerts']]}for r in rows]
  print('NATIVE_DUPLICATE_DIAGNOSIS:'+json.dumps({'route_overlap':compact(route_rows),'uncoordinated_senders':compact(coord_rows),'actual_cluster_states':[x['cluster']for x in states],'transport_retry':compact(retry_rows),'network_partition_was_not_injected_or_proven':True}),flush=True)
def recovery():
 m=student('restore.py')
 with Session()as s:
  directory=s.root/'original';directory.mkdir();(directory/'secret').mkdir();secret=directory/'secret/bearer.txt';secret.write_text('owned-fixture-token');secret.chmod(0o600);(directory/'owned.tmpl').write_text('{{ define "subject" }}Restored notification{{ end }}')
  config=basic_config();config['templates']=['owned.tmpl'];config['receivers'][0]['webhook_configs'][0].update(url='@WEBHOOK@/dr',http_config={'authorization':{'type':'Bearer','credentials_file':'secret/bearer.txt'}});s.bearer_hash=hashlib.sha256(b'Bearer owned-fixture-token').hexdigest();original=s.start_am(config,directory=directory);incident=payload({'alertname':'PersistentEvent','instance':'canary','service':'payments'});s.send(original,[incident]);s.receipt('/dr',lambda r:r['status_code']==200);now=time.time();closed=create_silence(original,silence_body('retired-ticket',now-.1,now+90));keep=create_silence(original,silence_body('ongoing-maintenance',now-.1,now+90));original.stop();backup=s.root/'offline-backup';shutil.copytree(directory,backup);assert (backup/'data/nflog').is_file()and(backup/'data/silences').is_file()
  current=s.start_am(config,directory=directory);assert request(current.base,'/api/v2/silence/'+closed,method='DELETE')[0]==200;assert expired(current,closed);current.stop();target=s.root/'restored';m.restore(str(backup),str(target));assert target.is_dir()
  for relative in ['config.json','owned.tmpl','secret/bearer.txt','data/silences']:assert (target/relative).is_file()and(target/relative).read_bytes()==(backup/relative).read_bytes(),relative
  assert (target/'secret/bearer.txt').stat().st_mode&0o077==0;restored=s.start_am(read_json(target/'config.json'),directory=target);assert request(restored.base,'/api/v2/alerts')[1]==[];assert silence(restored,closed)['status']['state']=='active'and silence(restored,keep)['status']['state']=='active';mark=time.monotonic();s.send(restored,[incident]);time.sleep(.8);assert not[r for r in s.rows('/dr')if r['received_at']>=mark and any(a['labels']['alertname']=='PersistentEvent'for a in r['payload']['alerts'])],'restored nflog must prevent immediate duplicate firing'
  s.send(restored,[payload({'alertname':'ClosedTicketRisk','instance':'old','service':'retired-ticket'}),payload({'alertname':'KeepMaintenance','instance':'keep','service':'ongoing-maintenance'})]);wait(lambda:closed in alert_row(restored,'ClosedTicketRisk')['status']['silencedBy']);m.reconcile(restored.base,[closed]);wait(lambda:not alert_row(restored,'ClosedTicketRisk')['status']['silencedBy']);assert keep in alert_row(restored,'KeepMaintenance')['status']['silencedBy'];assert expired(restored,closed)
  s.send(restored,[payload({'alertname':'NewEvent','instance':'new','service':'payments'})]);new=s.receipt('/dr',lambda r:r['received_at']>=mark and r['status_code']==200 and any(a['labels']['alertname']=='NewEvent'for a in r['payload']['alerts']));assert new['authorization_sha256']==s.bearer_hash;s.send(restored,[{**incident,'endsAt':stamp(time.time()-.05)}]);resolved=s.receipt('/dr',lambda r:r['received_at']>=mark and any(a['labels']['alertname']=='PersistentEvent'and a['status']=='resolved'for a in r['payload']['alerts']));render=s.root/'render.json';render.write_text(json.dumps(new['payload']));cmd=[AMDIR+'amtool','template','render','--template.glob='+str(target/'owned.tmpl'),'--template.text={{ template "subject" . }}','--template.data='+str(render)];result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8);assert result.returncode==0 and result.stdout.strip()=='Restored notification';s.trace.append({'argv':cmd,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout})
  print('NATIVE_STATE_RECOVERY:'+json.dumps({'version':'0.34.1','topology':'one isolated instance with cluster disabled','offline_backup_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(backup)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()for p in backup.rglob('*')if p.is_file()},'initial_alerts_empty':True,'same_event_firing_not_repeated':True,'stale_closed_ticket_silence_was_reintroduced_then_reconciled':closed,'preserved_active_silence':keep,'new_event':new['payload']['alerts'][0]['labels'],'recovery_status':resolved['payload']['status'],'secret_delivery_sha256':new['authorization_sha256'],'template_render':result.stdout.strip()}),flush=True)
def run(case):globals()[case]();print('ALL_TESTS_PASSED')
